text: The paper reports that weighted voting outperforms best-of-n with easy-trained reward models, which the authors hypothesize reflects reward over-optimization when a less powerful base model (Llemma) is trained on harder tasks. A 34b evaluator significantly improves a 7b generator and a 7b evaluator still improves a 34b generator, and weighted voting consistently surpasses majority voting with a more pronounced advantage on harder tasks.
title: Weighted voting with easy-trained reward models beats best-of-n, gains larger on hard
